prompt: Build a pay-per-call joke API that charges 0.005 USDC per request using x402

spec.name: JokePayPerCall
spec.description: A pay-per-call joke API that charges 0.005 USDC per request using the x402 protocol on Algorand

global_state.name: price_per_call
global_state.description: Price per call in microUSDC (5000 for 0.005 USDC)

global_state.name: total_jokes_served
global_state.description: Total number of jokes served via paid calls

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initialize the joke service with the specified price

methods.name: record_payment
methods.description: Verify and record payment from atomic group transaction (trustless — reads payment from gtxn)

methods.name: get_stats
methods.description: Get the total number of jokes served

methods.name: withdraw
methods.description: Owner withdraws accumulated USDC earnings from the contract

ui_requirements: Display current price per joke in USDC
Button to 'Buy a Joke' which triggers the x402 payment flow
Dashboard showing total jokes served and total revenue
business_logic: record_payment verifies that the payment transaction in the group is sent to the contract address
record_payment verifies the payment amount is greater than or equal to price_per_call
Only the owner address can call the withdraw method
The contract tracks usage statistics globally
